why: In today's tooling (.github/), wrote slice 1 of docs/plan/quests/t1161-scheduled-dispatch-scope-PLAN.md: scheduled.yaml's hand start gets a scope input (changed by default, or full) and a law input, proof.ts reads them (askOf, inProjects, the ask in the choice, the record and the summary), and workflow-lint/scheduled.ts gets SC21 and a wider SC17. Laws P6 to P13 are in proof.test.ts and S8 to S12 in scheduled.test.ts. Before the product edits P6, P8, P9, P10, P11 and P13 were red for the plan's reasons (a record without asked, askOf and inProjects missing) and S8, S9 and S12 were red once scheduled.yaml carried the inputs and the rule did not exist; the plan puts every slice 1 file under the exam path, so this step then wrote the product and all 320 tests of the two files are green. Each law's plant was run once and restored. D1 (one real dispatch at the default scope) is the lead's.
note: Started time is approximate (first observed container clock); usage and cost are not recorded. Model and effort are the requested values. This container has Node 22 where the pin is Node 26, so tests ran with CI=1 for the local-limit guard. git pull --ff-only hung on the network and was stopped; the worktree was already at the brief's head 7f4f47968. P12 is a type law: its plant was run through one narrow tsc over .github/ci (nice, one process), not pnpm typecheck; the same tsc passes on the final files. No test clones a repo; proof.ts's main block is never run by a test.
